posts.body_html:
March around here has been pretty rough after a rather warm February.  My plants in the outdoor bog are still hunkering down, although you can see their rhizomes swelling, ready to burst.  In my greenhouse, the plants are beginning to push through their blooms, but like Calen, the weather is making it difficult for them to get over the finish line.  

This pic was from a week ago, and honestly, nothing has really changed with a week of cold temps and two bouts of spring snow.

The plants kept at my uncle's greenhouse are another story.  They are growing like crazy with the warmer nights necessary for the his other crops.  None moreso than this guy:



It is one of my first plants, from Wes Buckner in 2014. I'm 75% sure it is Oreo Sand Mountain x Flava Jerry Addington Clone based on my list.  I got this plant when I only thought I'd get a few to throw in my pond bog, so I didn't really prioritize labeling.   Little did I know that a latent case of Sarraddiction would develop years later 

EDIT 3/27/18:  Okay, I've been looking through my old pics since 2014 and I'm actually now 75% sure this plant is actually Alata Black x Flava Veined.  Ughhhh....ALWAYS LABEL YOUR PLANTS
